in_sanskrit.name: मोहर
in_sanskrit.meaning: मूर्धान्यम्, मूर्धन्यम्, मोहनम्, मोहनम् (मोहना = to charm, to delight)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who charms or delights, the one who is priceless, valuable, precious.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who charms or delights, the one who is priceless, valuable, precious.

in_telugu.name: మోహర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is precious, valuable, priceless.

in_marathi.name: Mohar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to delight' or 'to charm'. The name Mohar is often used to describe something precious, golden, or delightful in Hindu culture.
